components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary conversion action, used for Register Club and other leading actions.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; border: 1px solid #ff555a; border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(110deg, #ed171b, #bb080c); color: #fff; font: 700 13px Inter, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .005em; box-shadow: 0 5px 20px #d4000040, inset 0 1px #ff797c75; transition: background .2s ease, transform .2s ease, border-color .2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #ef272b; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ff6b70; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary action that sits beside or below the primary CTA.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { min-height: 46px; padding: 0 20px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; border: 1px solid #bfc0c4; border-radius: 6px; background: #101114; color: #fff; font: 700 13px Inter, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .005em; transition: background .2s ease, transform .2s ease, border-color .2s ease; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button-outline:hover { border-color: #fff; background: #25262b; transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ff6b70; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-outline:active { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Dark horizontal desktop navigation with an active underline and CTA.
components.html: How It WorksFeaturesRegister Club
components.css: .ds-nav { min-height: 64px; padding: 0 20px; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; border-bottom: 1px solid #37383d; background: #090a0c; font: 600 12px Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; position: relative; color: #ececef; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #ff6469; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ff6b70; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 0; left: 0; height: 2px; background: #e10600; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-cta { min-height: 39px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #ff555a; border-radius: 6px; background: linear-gradient(110deg, #ed171b, #bb080c); color: #fff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav .ds-nav-cta:hover { background: #ef272b; }

components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 5px; color: #f0f0f1; font: 650 12px Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 45px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #53545a; border-radius: 5px; background: #0f1012; color: #fff; font: 400 13px Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #92939a; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #ff6b70; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-phone-stage { width: 190px; padding-top: 18px; position: relative; } .ds-phone-label { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; padding: 3px 6px; border: 1px solid #5a5b60; border-radius: 3px; background: #111216; color: #d3d4d7; font: 700 7px Inter, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-phone { min-height: 230px; padding: 20px 12px; border: 2px solid #85868b; border-radius: 23px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #17181c, #08090b); color: #d8d8da; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px #111, 0 13px 32px #000, 0 0 18px #e1060045; font: 400 9px Inter, Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-phone > small:first-child { font: italic 800 11px 'Barlow Condensed', Impact, sans-serif; color: #fff; } .ds-phone > small:first-child span { color: #ff3845; } .ds-phone p { margin: 17px 0 12px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-phone p b { color: #fff; font-size: 13px; } .ds-phone-program { padding: 7px 5px; border: 1px solid #70282a; border-radius: 5px; background: #2a1517; color: #f08083; font-size: 6px; letter-spacing: .08em; } .ds-phone-program strong { display: block; margin-top: 3px; color: #fff; font-size: 7px; letter-spacing: 0; } .ds-phone-progress { height: 6px; margin: 14px 0 5px; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 5px; background: #35363a; } .ds-phone-progress i { display: block; width: 72%; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(90deg, #d00, #ff4449); } .ds-phone > small:last-child { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; color: #d8d8da; font-size: 6px; } .ds-phone > small:last-child b { color: #fff; font-size: 9px; }

narrative.overview: FighterX follows its approved visual reference: a dark, cinematic sports interface built around real Silat Seni and Silat Olahraga cutouts, crimson light, and clear training information. Barlow Condensed gives display copy its athletic emphasis; Inter keeps navigation, details, and controls readable. Use the supplied visual assets as independent layers, with charcoal panels and restrained outlines to organize the interface.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black and charcoal surfaces with crimson actions and highlights.
Condensed display type paired with compact, readable interface text.
Mobile layouts retain the same hierarchy and give touch controls room.

rules.name: The Accent Restraint Rule
rules.body: Keep crimson on actions, active states, and small visual accents; do not turn every surface into a red glow.

dos: Do use supplied Silat cutouts independently and preserve their proportions.
Do keep the Register Club action prominent where the page asks clubs to convert.
Do retain readable contrast, visible keyboard focus, reduced-motion support, and touch-friendly mobile controls.
Do label product mockups and preview-only flows honestly.
donts: Don't use a reference screenshot as a page background.
Don't invent or redraw the official logo mark.
Don't describe supplied Malay-inspired textures as historically authentic patterns.
Don't spread crimson glow across every card or panel.
Don't rely on color alone to communicate status.
